pages.title: Overview
pages.markdown:
# Overview

This project describes our home: rooms, network, devices and what to do in an emergency.

> [!note]
> Devices and rooms are **entries** in the knowledge graph. Mention them with `@shortname` to link pages and entries. The *Network plan* draws itself.

## Next steps

- [ ] Add rooms as entries (kind *Room*)
- [ ] Add router, repeaters and switches and connect them with “uplink” or “wired to”
- [ ] Create a *floor plan* and place devices
- [ ] Fill in the *emergency folder*

## When the internet is down

1. Check the provider's outage page.
2. Unplug the router for 10 seconds.
3. Still nothing? Look at the *path to the network* on the router's page.
